resources._comment: Compute requirements. Used by /train-run to validate hardware match before launching long jobs.

param_injection._comment: One entry per runtime_params key. Records how a value actually reaches the code and whether an external override survives. CRITICAL: values in runtime_params must be the EFFECTIVE-at-runtime value — if a yaml says lr=3e-4 but code hardcodes 1e-4 after loading it, record 1e-4. Entry shape: {via, flag|key|env|derived_from, overridable, evidence, note}. via: cli | yaml | env | hardcoded | derived. overridable=false means /train-run must not pass it and /train-tune must not search it.
